_doc: PERMISSIVE NEGATIVE CONTROL for tests: Codex CLI host adapter. Packaged skills get agents/openai.yaml with allow_implicit_invocation=false (contract 5). `reviewer` describes the closed-context Codex reviewer child spawned by review.mjs when the author host is Claude (contract 7): read-only sandbox, no native output schema, every execution/delegation surface disabled by feature flag on the command line (adapter JSON → argv is the single effective configuration; there is no config file) and verified by a live negative probe.

registry._note: Codex exposes no documented installed-root file; the root comes from `codex plugin add --json` or the operator and is validated against the package marker (contract 2).
